intro: Hakuto-R Mission 2, named RESILIENCE, was ispace's second lander. It shared a Falcon 9 with Firefly's Blue Ghost on 15 January 2025, flew past the Moon in February and entered lunar orbit on 6 May 2025. On 5 June 2025 its laser range finder was slow to give valid altitudes, and the lander could not slow down enough: the last telemetry came from 192 m above Mare Frigoris.
